intent.goal: Reduce dsh-remote request latency by preserving HTTP upstream connections across the existing SSH reverse tunnel, deploy the reversible edge update, and remeasure the complete path without changing remote access behavior.
non_goals: Changing authentication, private-link, session rotation, or WebSocket semantics
Changing VPS provider, DNS, certificate, firewall, or public listener topology
Persisting DSH data on the VPS
Introducing a public reverse-tunnel TCP port

acceptance: US-R1 remains complete for authenticated HTTP, refresh, root-relative resources, APIs, and WebSocket traffic.

Post-deployment repeated tunnel and public requests show lower warm-request latency than the recorded cold baseline without availability regression.

Managed VPS preflight, apply receipt, and ready status
